scope: Native clients (no emulator) through the native C bridge (engine e2e3917e2, claude/native-pc), unchanged companions and an unchanged world server; presence only (no ownership store: saves, trades and battles have their own gates). Ordinary key presses on each client's own X display.
note: The companion verifies the GBA ROM and manifest of the same engine source; the native executable is a separate artefact of that source, identified by game_sha256.
